project.title: Remote Desktop Services (RDS) / Thin Client Implementation

parentsummary.deliverables: Replaced aged desktop infrastructure across Dymon Health Care retirement residences with a centralized Citrix XenServer and Windows 2012 R2 RDS thin client solution, delivering roaming profiles for nursing staff and centralized data management with Canadian PIPEDA compliance.
parentsummary.outcomes: Modernized end-user computing across healthcare residences, eliminating aging multi-OS desktop infrastructure and centralizing user data and roaming profiles in a PIPEDA-compliant architecture that improved both operational efficiency and regulatory posture.

challenge.summary: The Dymon Health Care retirement residences were operating with heavily aged systems. A Terminal Server (RDS) / Thin Client model was selected to provide roaming profiles for nursing staff while centralizing data on corporate servers.

deliverables: Stakeholder reporting and meetings with CIO & Health Care COO
Needs analysis, define requirements, and plan transformation
Staged migratory testing of services with inline remediation
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls with compliance to Canadian PIPEDA
Preparation and planning for repurposing or decommission of legacy hardware
Documentation preparation for Operations staff including knowledge transfer and cross-training

outcomes: ✅ Replaced aging multi-OS desktop infrastructure with centralized Citrix XenServer and Windows 2012 R2 RDS thin client solution
✅ Centralized user data and roaming profiles achieving PIPEDA compliance for healthcare data
